sanskrit_verse:
दूतीप्रस्थापनैश् चैव लेखासंप्रेषणैर् अपि।
अन्यैर् अपि व्यभिचारैः सर्वं संग्रहणं स्मृतम्॥
transliteration: dūtīprasthāpanaiś caiva lekhāsaṃpreṣaṇair api | anyair api vyabhicāraiḥ sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The comprehensive gathering of evidence includes the deployment of envoys, dispatch of written communications, and all other forms of investigative action that reveal transgression.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The right to deploy investigative means rests with those empowered to uphold Dharma.
Causation: Evidence-gathering actions are causally linked to the restoration of truth.
Capacity-based responsibility: Only those with the capacity to act may initiate such procedures.
Restoration logic: All investigative methods serve the purpose of restoring alignment with Dharma.
Consciousness alignment: Truth-revealing processes must align with the consciousness of the accused and accuser.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a transgression is reported THEN authorized agents MAY deploy envoys to gather factual data.
IF written communication is required for verification THEN it SHALL be dispatched through authenticated channels.
IF alternative investigative methods are necessary THEN they MUST be employed without violating Dharma.
ALL investigative actions MUST preserve the integrity and free-will capacity of involved parties.
EVIDENCE collected MUST directly contribute to consciousness realignment and factual restoration.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse authorizes the use of diplomatic, documentary, and auxiliary investigative tools when ordinary judicial inquiry proves insufficient. Responsibility lies with the presiding authority to ensure these measures remain within Dharma-aligned bounds, prioritizing consciousness restoration over coercive fact-finding.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This provision aligns with Nyaya by establishing pramāṇa-based investigation as foundational to justice. It reflects anupūrvaśaḥ in that each step taken reveals deeper layers of reality. Responsibility is proportional to capacity, and enforcement remains non-punitive, aimed solely at uncovering truth and restoring harmony.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Deployment Protocol: Assign trained dūtīs (investigative agents) who operate under Dharma-bound oaths.
Document Transmission Protocol: Ensure lekhāsaṃpreṣaṇa (written dispatches) carry certified authenticity markers.
Alternative Investigation Protocol: Employ vyabhicāra-adhikaraṇa (circumstantial inquiry paths) only after direct methods have been exhausted.
Integrity Restoration Protocol: Realign investigative participants with their svadharma post-inquiry.
Completion Confirmation Protocol: Verify that all gathered information contributes to full consciousness realignment.
final_declaration: All investigative actions originate from the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma. Justice flows not through punishment but through the revelation of truth and the restoration of conscious alignment. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates.
